{{Quote|Well, regardless, the Sith don't let anybody near that valley. Even when we land, they watch us like a Drayberian hawk and want us gone quickly.|The pilot, on the Valley of the Dark Lords|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Human''' worked as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. They transported [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] excavated by members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] at the ancient Sith [[Burial/Legends|tombs]] of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] offworld.<ref name="KOTOR" />
